craft_notes: Sthāyin: charter — two doors, one road (owner reviews first-verse of chapter). Sanskrit-first: sabījā kept as seeded (not caused); ājīvaṃ lifelong. Rows: doors line-final. Rejected: softening initiations into blessings — killed: dīkṣā technical. Read aloud: double door, single road.

lines: There — for the ripe, the rite to ripen refinement;
for the unripe, seeded freedom. Once given, the master maps life's remainder.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra yā dīkṣā saṃskārasiddhyai jñānayogyān prati yā ca tadaśaktān prati mokṣadīkṣā sabījā tasyāṃ kṛtāyām ājīvaṃ śeṣavartanaṃ guruḥ upadiśet
